description: Investment portfolios on a wealth-management platform: what accounts and households hold, model portfolios and target weights, asset allocation, drift and tolerance bands, rebalancing, market value and quarter-end AUM valuations and their price corrections, why an account's market value or AUM changed (market movement, contributions, withdrawals), cash sweep, held-away assets, and investment performance and returns.

read_tools.get_household_portfolio: Returns one account's current portfolio by its account id: holdings, allocation against its model, drift and total value.
read_tools.get_aum_history: Returns one account's quarter-end AUM valuations by its account id, oldest first, with each quarter's change.
read_tools.list_my_accounts: Lists the accounts the signed-in user can access: id, name, household, model portfolio and currency. Takes no account id.

subject: investment portfolios

intent.data: an account's portfolio: what an account holds, its allocation, drift or AUM

scope_summary.en: portfolios (holdings, model portfolios, drift, rebalancing, quarter-end AUM)
scope_summary.bg: с портфейлите (позиции, моделни портфейли, отклонение, ребалансиране, AUM към края на тримесечието)
